calibrationExamples.summary: American Cocker Spaniels tend to be merry, even-tempered dogs with a keen inclination to work. They combine considerable speed with endurance in a compact sporting frame, and their traditional flushing role sits alongside their role as companions.
calibrationExamples.shortDescription: A merry, even-tempered American flushing spaniel with endurance and a keen inclination to work.

calibrationExamples.displayName: English Cocker Spaniel, Particolours (Bicolours, Tricolours, Roans)
calibrationExamples.summary: English Cocker Spaniels tend to be affectionate, exuberant dogs whose busy energy comes alive when they follow a scent. Their woodcock-flushing roots help explain the breed’s willingness to push through heavy cover. They emerged as a separate breed from Field and Springer Spaniels after Britain’s Kennel Club was formed in 1873.
calibrationExamples.shortDescription: An affectionate, exuberant English spaniel whose bustling energy comes alive when following scent.
calibrationExamples.role: Read full original and complete source/QA packet for calibration; never regenerate this accepted asset.

calibrationExamples.summary: Estrela Mountain Dogs tend to be watchful flock guardians, closely attached to the shepherd while wary of unfamiliar people. Their work developed across Portugal’s Estrela Mountains, following herds from the foothills to summer pasture high above the lowlands. Guarding against predators and thieves remains central to the breed’s character.
calibrationExamples.shortDescription: A watchful Portuguese mountain guardian, attached to its shepherd and wary of unfamiliar people.
calibrationExamples.role: Read full original and complete source/QA packet for calibration; never regenerate this accepted asset.

calibrationExamples.summary: Hovawarts tend to combine an even, confident disposition with protectiveness and strong attachment to familiar people. A good nose supports their use in tracking and rescue as well as watch and guard work. The modern breed was rebuilt from German farm dogs beginning in 1922, carrying forward an older estate-guardian idea.
calibrationExamples.shortDescription: An even, confident German guardian whose good nose also supports tracking and rescue work.
calibrationExamples.role: Read full original and complete source/QA packet for calibration; never regenerate this accepted asset.

calibrationExamples.displayName: King Charles Spaniel, Black And Tan
calibrationExamples.summary: King Charles Spaniels tend to be gentle and affectionate, with a reserved side that can coexist with a happy disposition. These companion spaniels descend from small gundogs later cherished by wealthy owners, and their name remembers King Charles II’s fondness for them.
calibrationExamples.shortDescription: A gentle, affectionate toy spaniel with a reserved side and a long history of close companionship.
